modelReview.summary: The manuscript lacks essential information: definitions of predictor and outcome, cohort construction details, calibration assessment, and confidence intervals. The reporting is placeholder-like, making the results uninterpretable for clinical or research use.

findings.title: Predictor and outcome are undefined
findings.whyItMatters: Without clinical or operational definitions of 'pred_score' and 'outcome_binary', the discrimination metrics are meaningless to readers and cannot support any clinical interpretation.
findings.actionableFix: Provide clear definitions including the source, derivation, units, and clinical meaning for the risk score, and define the binary outcome event, measurement method, and prevalence.
findings.deterministicVerification: Verify that the Variables section of the manuscript contains explicit, non-generic descriptions for each variable.

findings.title: No calibration assessment performed
findings.whyItMatters: For a prediction model evaluation, calibration is as important as discrimination; a well-discriminating but miscalibrated model can produce dangerously misleading risk estimates.
findings.actionableFix: Add calibration evaluation: calibration plot, calibration-in-the-large, calibration slope, and optionally Hosmer-Lemeshow test; report these metrics alongside AUROC.
findings.deterministicVerification: Check that the artifact diagnostics.json or output files contain calibration metrics and a calibration plot figure.

findings.title: Cohort construction is opaque
findings.whyItMatters: Generalizability, potential selection bias, and data quality cannot be assessed without knowing data source, inclusion/exclusion criteria, and how the 240 complete-cases were obtained.
findings.actionableFix: Describe the data source, study period, eligibility criteria, exclusion steps (e.g., via a flow chart), and any missing data handling; link to a cohort definition artifact.
findings.deterministicVerification: Check that the manuscript or a referenced cohort artifact contains a step-by-step construction flow and raw case counts.

findings.title: AUROC reported without confidence interval
findings.whyItMatters: Without a confidence interval, the precision of the discrimination estimate is unknown; it is impossible to judge whether the model performs better than chance or acceptably for clinical use.
findings.actionableFix: Compute and report a 95% confidence interval for the AUROC (e.g., DeLong method or bootstrap), and include it in both stats-run output and manuscript.
findings.deterministicVerification: Check that the estimates artifact or manuscript contains an AUROC confidence interval field.

findings.title: Brier score lacks interpretative context
findings.whyItMatters: A Brier score of 0.1925 is difficult to judge without knowing outcome prevalence or a null-model Brier score; readers cannot assess the magnitude of improvement over a naive prediction.
findings.actionableFix: Report outcome prevalence and either the Brier skill score (scaled by maximum possible Brier) or the Brier score of a non-informative model (e.g., predicting the mean).
findings.deterministicVerification: Check that the manuscript or stats-run summary includes prevalence and a normalized Brier metric.

findings.title: Manuscript uses placeholder language and lacks substantive content
findings.whyItMatters: The manuscript reads as a generic template: methods state 'cohort definition was read from available run artifacts', discussion is boilerplate, and no concrete clinical context is provided. This fails to communicate the study effectively.
findings.actionableFix: Rewrite the manuscript to include: Background with clinical rationale, detailed Methods with source and cohort specifics, Results with confidence intervals and calibration, Discussion interpreting the findings in context, and focused Limitations.
findings.deterministicVerification: Check that the manuscript contains sections with specific, non-canned text including references to actual data source, variable definitions, and numeric results beyond the reported metrics.

findings.title: Manuscript QA artifact content not provided
findings.whyItMatters: The review packet lists manuscript-qa.json but omits its content; we cannot verify that manuscript-level QA checks (consistency, claim alignment) were performed and passed.
findings.actionableFix: Include the content of manuscript-qa.json in the review packet for the next review cycle.
findings.deterministicVerification: Check that the artifact packet contains a non-empty manuscript-qa.json with a status field.

findings.title: ROC curve figure not referenced in manuscript text
findings.whyItMatters: The available ROC curve could aid interpretation, but it is not mentioned in the results or discussion, reducing the report's completeness.
findings.actionableFix: Add a sentence in the Results section describing the ROC curve and referencing the figure, and include the figure in the manuscript or appendix.
findings.deterministicVerification: Search the manuscript text for 'ROC' or 'Figure' to confirm presence of the reference.

missingEvidence: cohort construction artifact (flow chart, eligibility documentation)
variable dictionary with definitions and units
raw data summary (outcome prevalence, predictor distribution) not included
